q: How do I work out precursor emissions when I buy the same steel from several suppliers?
title: CBAM precursor from several suppliers
short: Take each supplier's embedded emissions per tonne and weight it by the tonnes you consumed from them in the period. Where a supplier gives no figure, use the default value for that share. Keep the purchase register that shows tonnes by supplier, because the verifier will check the weights.
audience: Downstream steel and aluminium processors with several material suppliers

ol: List tonnes consumed from each supplier in the reporting period.
Collect each supplier's figure and installation details.
Multiply and add, then divide by total tonnes used.

p: Use tonnes consumed, not bought. Opening and closing stock shift the weights when purchases are lumpy.

example.title: Worked example
lines: Mill A: 600 t at 2.0 t CO2 per t = 1,200 t CO2
Mill B: 400 t at 2.5 t CO2 per t = 1,000 t CO2
Weighted precursor figure: 2,200 / 1,000 t = 2.2 t CO2 per t

senseible: Senseible reads fuel, power and production records into dated, fingerprinted installation records, the starting point for the actual emissions your EU importer asks for.
